config.baseline_authority: User: 90% LTV, 4% interest, 35 years, management-fee coverage, preferred 6% gross yield
config.other_parameters_authority: Inherited synthetic comparison assumptions; not user finances, legal cost quotations or approved return targets
config.cost_boundary: Fee input is a combined service/sinking proxy; other cost is an allowance. Base figures are pre-tax and omit unquoted transaction-specific costs. Unknown costs are not verified zero.

limitations: Pre-tax conditional arithmetic; no diversity or rail premium, actual costs or achieved rent authenticated. Unknown costs not zero. 8% hurdle illustrative.

relative_reversals.boundary: Carry equivalence does not recover extra upfront capital or establish equal total return. Same-percentage exits and equal-absolute exits are separate counterfactuals, not forecasts.

joint_stress.boundary: Correlated shock with no assumed tenant diversification; synthetic reserves, not a recommended allocation. Year two reverts to eleven paid months at stressed rent/rate.
